description: Village blacksmith's forge hearth of rough grey fieldstone, lit: waist-high stone fire bed (top 0.74 m) with capstones round a sunken fire pit of glowing charcoal (emissive: white-yellow over the tuyere mouth, orange, dull red, dark clinker at the edges), a flat-lintelled ash pit under the front, a stone back wall to 2.4 m, a riveted black sheet-iron lean-to hood over the fire narrowing into a square stone chimney to ~3.45 m, an iron tuyere (air pipe) entering the left (-X) side at 0.62 m with a flared mouth for a bellows nozzle. Soot up the hood, wall and chimney. Back flat against a wall. Cold twin: forge_hearth_stone_01.

paint.prompt: rough grey fieldstone blocks of different sizes laid in thick lime mortar, chipped and weathered, soot-blackened above the fire and up the chimney, heat-cracked and pale around the fire pit, ash dust on the ledges; a riveted black sheet-iron hood, sooty and rust-streaked; charcoal lumps in the fire pit, glowing orange and red in the centre, dark at the edges; a rusty iron air pipe
